# iOS launch images

Launch-screen image assets for **Escooter Next**, the independent replacement for Vicont's companion app. See the [project overview](../../../../../README.md) for the app's purpose and scooter support.

These images belong to the iOS launch screen. Home-screen icons live in the neighbouring `AppIcon.appiconset` and are generated by [generate_icons.py](../../../../tool/generate_icons.py).

See the [iOS build instructions](../../../../../docs/BUILDING.md) for Xcode, Windows builds and icon packaging.
